ladder.label: NEARING A LOW
ladder.why: Day 53 of a typical 36-42-day cycle — inside the window where lows usually form. No confirmed turn yet. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Wait for the turn: a move above the low candle's high, then a close back above the 10-day average. Daily momentum is ~10 bars from a bullish cross.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 11 · daily cycle day 53).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a low. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
